Callout.Name: Fire at a Timber Yard
Callout.Message: Fire in a timber yard, spreading through stacks.

Script.Line: It has taken two stacks and it is moving along the row.
The stacks are thirty feet apart and the wind is across them.
Everybody is out and accounted for. Nobody is going back in.

Lines.Approach: It has taken two stacks and it is walking along the row. Every stack is the same distance apart.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
